speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: asked the Minister for Manpower what steps is the Ministry taking to (i) leverage the investment and efforts by Workforce Singapore to include and integrate unemployed but employable persons with disabilities into the Singapore core and (ii) advise and collaborate with social sector agencies to ensure that persons with disabilities are prepared adequately for the future economy to prevent them from further marginalisation.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Persons with special needs can tap on these services too, as well as the programmes to find suitable employment, particularly the Open Door Programme (ODP) and Career Trial.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The programme provides employers with recruitment and job support services, as well as grants to redesign jobs for persons with special needs to upgrade their skills and even train co-workers to work better together with persons with special needs.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Under the Third Enabling Masterplan, the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) has been actively engaging persons with special needs and their caregivers to better understand their aspirations, needs and challenges.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The Government is also working closely with social service agencies and other partners in the private and people sectors to improve education, training and job placement for persons with special needs and identify suitable employment opportunities for them.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
text: So, in itself, without even comparing to what or how the other countries are doing, I would like to ask the Ministry and maybe even MSF, is there something of a national target that we are internally working towards?

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
text: At 5%, given the resources we have and how fast the nature of work is changing, I do fear that this group of people with disabilities would be further marginalised.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
text: It will not bring them into the workforce and, on top of that, also continue to upgrade and prepare them for the future of work.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
text: Could I please ask the Minister of State what sort of plans do we have in that regard?

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: We want to see more inclusive workspaces here in Singapore.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Specific to that article, I think much of the data was picked up from data available in the public space.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: But overall, if you look at where we are today compared to, say, four or five years ago when we first set up SG Enable, then subsequently we developed WSG to come in to support, we have worked quite closely to look at how we can improve employability.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: I think the situation has improved, as I have mentioned.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Today, we have got 1,600 being placed in the last three years.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: But if you look at the schemes out there, are there enough schemes?

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: On top of that, if you look at the Special Employment Credit, the Government provides up to 16% wage subsidy to employers to employ persons with special needs regardless of age for those above 65.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: This goes up to 22% of wages for employing someone with special needs who are more senior.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: So, to a certain extent, overall, there is support, but what I hope is that we can get more enlightened employers on board.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: I think Members of this House have friends, neighbours, industry contacts, employers who can help and join this inclusive workplace initiative or aspiration for all of us.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: But I hope that we can get more employers on board because the engines are there, the schemes are there.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Certainly, we can all work together towards this aspiration.
